prior_art_boundary: Wang et al. 2024 already establish a pooled departure-to-arrival carry-over path in spring and autumn.
Franklin et al. 2022 meta-analyze within-stage repeatability across 47 species; that is not the same estimand as within-migration departure-to-arrival retention.
Morbey and Schmaljohann 2020 compare migration speed/departure traits across 25 songbird species; they do not estimate species-specific departure-to-arrival retention.
Linssen et al. 2025 quantify fuelling-time flexibility in five Arctic-breeding waterfowl; this is a narrower taxonomic and different flexibility metric.

candidate_novel_estimand.name: species_specific_within_migration_timing_retention
candidate_novel_estimand.definition: Within a species, beta_s is the slope linking individual departure-date anomaly to arrival-date anomaly during one migration season after removing study-year mean timing. beta_s=1 denotes complete carry-over, beta_s=0 complete reset, beta_s<0 over-correction.

eligibility_gate.fail_if: Fewer than 20 species have >=8 individual-level paired records with nonzero within-stratum departure variation in at least one season.

preprocessing.date_coordinate: day-of-year on source migration year; no circular transformation unless source schema requires it
preprocessing.sex_handling: If sex is available, report sensitivity after subtracting sex-specific mean within eligible strata; do not select between versions by outcome.
preprocessing.no_outlier_trimming: No outcome-based trimming; only impossible dates or documented source errors may be excluded.

primary_analysis.stage_1: Estimate beta_s separately by species and season using arrival_anomaly ~ 0 + departure_anomaly.
primary_analysis.uncertainty: Cluster/bootstrap at study-year stratum when at least 3 strata exist; otherwise HC3 robust SE and flag limited clustering.
primary_analysis.stage_2: Random-effects meta-analysis of beta_s across species; report tau^2 and I^2.
primary_analysis.primary_test: Is between-species heterogeneity in beta_s greater than sampling error?
primary_analysis.paired_season_test: Among species eligible in both seasons, estimate mean beta_spring - beta_autumn with species-paired bootstrap.
primary_analysis.interpretation: Do not equate beta_s with internal feedback gain; it is a descriptive timing-retention coordinate.

moderator_analysis.purpose: Test whether migration geometry and body size explain heterogeneity in spring beta_s.
moderator_analysis.direction: two-sided because recourse-opportunity and time-constraint mechanisms make opposing predictions.

admission_rule.comparative_route_supported: At least 20 eligible species and heterogeneity test estimable.
admission_rule.stronger_ecological_result: At least one preregistered moderator or spring-autumn contrast has interval excluding zero after declared uncertainty treatment.
admission_rule.null_route: If heterogeneity is small or moderators/season contrast are unresolved, report as a bounded comparative null; do not invent new subgroup cuts.

transparency: The Wang dataset has been used previously for pooled SEM; PAYOFF-B cannot claim discovery that departure predicts arrival.
No numerical timing values may be inspected before this contract is committed.
Schema probing may inspect file names, sheet names, headers and row counts only.
